blocks.text: This prefatory citation page gathers sources used in the introduction, including Hukamnamas edited by Dr Ganda Singh, Dr Kirpal Singh’s History of the Sikhs and Their Religion, Dr M. S. Ahluwalia’s work, and Dr Balwant Singh Dhillon’s edition of Sri Gur Panth Prakash.

The remaining lines preserve transliterated verse citations and dohra or chaupai fragments used by the editor to support the surrounding discussion about lineage, Panth, sovereignty, and the Guru’s purpose.
The page functions as citation apparatus: a mixture of bibliography and verse evidence that belongs to the introduction rather than a standalone historical scene.
